nodes.name: Sendr Webhook
nodes.notes: Registered as a Sendr WORKSPACE webhook (POST /api/v1/webhook), not a per-page inline one — Sendr scopes an inline webhookUrl to a single generated page, so it can't serve as a standing subscription. Responds immediately and processes async, so a 200 here proves delivery, never that the logic ran; check executions.

nodes.name: Notify Human (Slack)
nodes.notes: A plain notification, deliberately NOT sendAndWait. There is nothing to approve here: a page view or a click is an intent signal, not a decision point, and approving one must never become a shortcut into a call. The Approve/Decline gate lives in VIO-inbound-reply-to-call, downstream of a real confirmed reply.

nodes.name: Log Only (page views, renders)
nodes.notes: Warm signals and render lifecycle events land here. TODO: append a Google Sheets Events write once the Sheet + VIO Google Sheets OAuth exist — until then the execution log is the record.
